ops.entry: WHEN a verify asserts by text search DO make the match discriminate: a fixture id containing the asserted token matches whatever reason prints, and an erroring search passes a zero-count test. Name fixtures free of asserted tokens; assert the search's exit status or pair it with a positive control.
ops.why: Plan authored fixture ids containing the asserted token; a reason-dropping mutant stayed green until validate. Same blind-match family as G-14 (search passes regardless), so merged into it rather than displacing a survivor at a full section.

originals.original: WHEN a verify asserts absence by counting DO NOT wrap the search in `test "$(cmd | wc -l)" = 0`: a search that errors prints nothing, the count is zero and the test passes. Assert the search's exit status, or pair it with a positive control that must match.
